title: (RHBA-2017:0972) RHEL Atomic AMI Release 7.3.4
portal_summary: Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic AMI Release 7.3.4 is now available.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic Host|7|x86_64
portal_solution: This is a cumulative update for Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic Host. To upgrade your Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic Host use the "atomic host upgrade" command on your system.
portal_description:
An updated version of Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic Host is available as
an OSTree. The following changes are included in this version. Each change
is represented by an RPM name and an Errata number. You can find the
details of each change by searching for the errata number at
http://access.redhat.com/.
